{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float
df_clean['revenue_float'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (df_clean['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check if refunded orders are included in revenue
refunded_revenue = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'refunded']['revenue_float'].sum()
print("Total revenue from refunded orders:", refunded_revenue)

# Remove refunded orders
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Final number of rows
print("Final number of completed orders:", len(df_final))"}
